env_vars.name: CODE_REVIEW_EFFORT
env_vars.description: Execution effort. Set to `min` for Quick Mode.

env_vars.name: CODE_REVIEW_AGENTS
env_vars.description: Comma-separated agent names to run. Defaults to all 14, filtered by project dimensions.

env_vars.name: CODE_REVIEW_STATUS_INTERVAL
env_vars.description: Minimum seconds between event-driven status log lines ('X/Y agents completed'). Status is emitted on agent result receipt, not on a background timer.

env_vars.name: CODE_REVIEW_FILTER
env_vars.description: Output filter. Set to `critical-high` to show only CRITICAL and HIGH severity findings in the report.

env_vars.name: REVIEW_MAX_ITERATIONS
env_vars.description: Maximum review-fix loop iterations in Phase 5. Set higher for thorough PR quality gates.

env_vars.name: CODE_REVIEW_SANITIZE
env_vars.description: Enable input sanitization for bot comments (Unicode normalization, path validation, shell command stripping).

env_vars.name: CODE_REVIEW_AUTO_APPROVE
env_vars.description: Auto-approve threshold for external loop fixes. `all` = auto-apply everything, `low` = only LOW/MEDIUM, `none` = require approval for all.

env_vars.name: CODE_REVIEW_FORMAT
env_vars.description: Output format. `markdown` = human-readable report, `json` = machine-parseable report, `both` = both formats.

agents.name: Architecture Analyzer
agents.coverage: Module coupling, layering violations, circular deps, patterns
checks: Before claiming a bundler includes a module, inspect package.json browser/exports and the bundler resolve config.
Distinguish a layering violation from a real import cycle.

agents.name: Code Quality Auditor
agents.coverage: Dead code, complexity (cyclomatic/cognitive), lint density, anti-patterns
checks: Inspect loops whose termination depends on external mutation (RegExp.exec without /g, lastIndex).
Check exported helpers for reachable edge cases, not just internal callers.

agents.name: Security Posture
agents.coverage: Secrets in code, dependency CVEs, auth patterns, OWASP checklist
checks: For allowlists and redaction, check whether the value comes from the same merged config an attacker can override.
Treat opt-in safety controls as design notes unless the default has no safe path.

agents.name: Tech Debt Tracker
agents.coverage: TODO/FIXME/HACK density, outdated patterns, migration status

agents.name: Test Health Auditor
agents.coverage: Coverage % by module, test quality (assertions vs snapshots), CI flakiness
checks: Flag live-network tests and fixed ports; they make CI non-deterministic.
Check that coverage thresholds exist and are enforced.

agents.name: Dependency Auditor
agents.coverage: Outdated major/minor/patch, license compliance, supply chain risk
checks: Check lockfile and update policy for security-patch lag.

agents.name: Documentation Auditor
agents.coverage: README quality, API docs coverage, architecture docs, inline doc density

agents.name: Build & CI Auditor
agents.coverage: Build time trends, cache effectiveness, CI reliability, config drift
checks: Compare every CI matrix entry against the runtime the tooling requires (e.g. mocha 11 needs Node >=18).
Confirm release and publish jobs depend on every test job.

agents.name: Performance Baseline
agents.coverage: N+1 queries, O(n^2) patterns, memory allocation hotspots, bundle size
checks: Any performance claim needs a measured or structurally derivable cost.

agents.name: Database & Schema
agents.coverage: Schema design, index health, migration history, raw SQL patterns

agents.name: UI/UX Auditor
agents.coverage: Visual consistency, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), responsive design, component reuse, UX patterns, form/input ergonomics

agents.name: DevOps & Infra
agents.coverage: Dockerfile quality, infra-as-code, secret management, deployment safety

agents.name: Standards Compliance
agents.coverage: Style guide adherence, naming conventions, file organization
checks: Only report a style violation when the repository config enforces it.

agents.name: Process Quality (Karpathy Compliance)
agents.coverage: Commit atomicity, over-engineering (YAGNI), surfaced assumptions, goal-driven verification, absence of vibe coding. Scores /10.
